name: push ups
description: Standard push ups. Keep your back flat and lower until your chest is just above the floor.

name: knee push ups
description: Push ups from your knees. Keep a straight line from knees to shoulders, lower your chest with control.

name: jumping jacks
description: Jump with legs spread and hands touching overhead, then return to a standing position.

name: high knees
description: Run in place driving your knees up to hip height. Stay light on the balls of your feet.

name: glute bridges
description: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips toward the ceiling and squeeze.

name: supermans
description: Lie face down, arms extended forward. Lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor and hold briefly.

name: bird dog
description: On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg until parallel to the floor. Alternate sides.

name: dead bug
description: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent at 90. Lower opposite arm and leg without arching your back.

name: bodyweight squats
description: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit back into your heels, knees tracking over toes.

name: lunges
description: Step forward with one leg until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle. Alternate legs.

name: reverse lunges
description: Step backward into a lunge, keeping the front knee over the ankle. Push through the front heel to return.

name: wall sit
description: Back flat against a wall, slide down until thighs are parallel to the floor. Hold the position.

name: plank
description: Hold a push-up position on your forearms. Keep your core tight and body in a straight line.

name: side plank
description: Balance on one forearm and the side of one foot, hips lifted. Keep your body in a straight line.

name: bicycle crunches
description: Lie on your back, hands behind head. Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee in a pedalling motion.

name: burpees
description: Squat, kick legs back, push up, jump them in, jump up. One fluid rep.

name: mountain climbers
description: In a plank position, quickly alternate bringing your knees toward your chest as if running.

name: jump squats
description: Drop into a squat then explode upward. Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

name: pike push ups
description: From a downward-dog position, bend your elbows to lower your head toward the floor, then press back up.

name: tricep dips
description: Hands on a chair edge behind you, legs extended. Bend your elbows to lower your hips, then press back up.

name: single-leg glute bridges
description: Glute bridge with one leg extended toward the ceiling. Drive through the planted heel and squeeze the glute.
